_comment: Shared ATS tenants: several listed companies post on ONE portal. A job may only be published under a company when the posting itself (legal entity / business unit / organization field, or a site that belongs to exactly one company) identifies that company. Anything else is stored as OWNER_UNRESOLVED and never shown. 'site_owner' entries are exclusive career sites - confirm each with `manage.py verify_job_links --sample` before relying on them.

ADANIPORTS: adani ports and special economic zone
